question: Does the surrogate↔hi-fi rank correlation generalise across the s011 cohort, and are multi-solution candidates cohort-scale rather than seed-10-specific?
hypothesis: Surrogate↔hi-fi rank correlation holds cohort-wide; the lowest-surrogate-MSE selector returns a Band A candidate per recoverable seed, and multi-solution candidates appear across seeds.
narrative_md: Cohort-scale ρ-band of s011 non-basin + s005 (n=576, 94 min). Surrogate↔hi-fi Spearman 0.9952 cohort-wide; 9/9 seeds pass ≥0.995 once 11 hi-fi-inf candidates are excluded; surrogate-best ρ matches hi-fi-best on 9/9 — the cohort selector returns a Band A candidate without a hi-fi rerank. Multi-solution candidates are cohort-scale (16 in cohort A across seeds 28/41/48/84, pattern: ω matches truth tightly, q0 far). Surrogate≈hi-fi MSE to <1% in the non-basin regime; ~20x larger near truth (surrogate noise floor).
